record.question: Which book was the Mizo Academy of Letters' Book of the Year 2012?
record.explanation: The MAL award chronology lists Sihlipui by Romuanpuii Zadeng as the 2012 Book of the Year. The date is the award’s book year, not the publication date of a later list. Reference: https://dcserchhip.mizoram.gov.in/page/mizo-academy-of-letters-book-of-the-year-list; https://in.boell.org/sites/default/files/after_decades_of_silence_voices_from_mizoram.pdf. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
